mainEntity.name: What is the difference between local SEO and general SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: General SEO aims to improve a website's visibility on a national or global scale for broad keywords, focusing on overall organic traffic. Local SEO, however, targets geographic-specific searches, aiming to attract customers within a defined service area. While both involve technical optimization and content, local SEO places a stronger emphasis on Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, and geo-targeted keywords. A local business typically needs a strategy that prioritizes local SEO to compete effectively in their specific market.
